transcript.answer: Yes. Issue #498 in re-cinq/Otto, "Stop the tool-budget message promising a follow-up while no escalation destination exists", is open. It is labeled type:bug, priority:medium, area:compliance and lore:blocked, and it was opened on 2026-10-23. The message TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA ends with "En kollega vil følge op på din henvendelse" (a colleague will follow up). The agent shows it when the tool budget runs out and records a tool_budget_exhausted escalation. No escalation destination is configured, because KU-14 is open, so nobody is notified to make the follow-up. The issue is blocked on a decision about what the message may promise (KU-14) and on a Danish speaker for any new wording (KU-15). FR-017 does not forbid a promised follow-up, so its test still passes. PR #495 raised the same concern.

judgements.reason: The answer identifies open issue #498 labelled lore:blocked, explains the follow-up message notifies nobody because no escalation destination is configured, and states it is blocked on KU-14 and a Danish speaker (KU-15).
